title: Minimax Wasserstein Rates for Latent Effect Laws from Proxies under Weak Rank
banked_reason: Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal (rewind D-1.2).
gap_reasons: The contribution remains confined to binary proxies and two latent classes, while the floor-free extension proves only a deterministic modulus and supplies no corresponding estimator, confidence procedure, or minimax theorem.

The proposed lattice estimator and profiled confidence image have no computational guarantee, and the claimed SPO consumer remains source-level because its execution defects prevent reproducible evidence.
paper_score_ceiling 7 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the supplied-strength four-criterion rate, its homogeneous lower experiment, and a deterministic floor-free self-normalized modulus; the decision and math referees passed with citations verified. The field-tier extension stopped at floor-free statistical inference, broader latent classes, and a computational guarantee, so D0.5 assigned subfield below the required field floor.
tldr: Under the ten-percent joint latent--arm floor, the paper proves two distinct matched four-criterion benchmarks for the causal latent effect law. On observable covariance slices, a strength-free total positive-law lattice estimator and a globally honest profiled image achieve \(\min\{1,(\sqrt n\,g)^{-1}\}\), and a homogeneous confounded lower path proves this rate sharp for full risk, known-homogeneity risk, honest maximal diameter, and honest diameter evaluated only at homogeneous laws. On the separately defined supplied-singular-strength class \(\mathcal M_s(s)\), the same four criteria have exact order \(\min\{1,(\sqrt n\,s^2)^{-1}\}\). The procedures use neither \(g\) nor \(s\). Bonald--Combes has priority for triangular weak-view rescaling; the new result is the causal two-arm quotient-law embedding with unknown composition and homogeneous-effect estimation and confidence converses.
gap: VMW identifies the effect law under strict positivity and qualitative full column rank, but its perturbation theory uses fixed latent conditioning.  The closest quotient-law theorem also treats latent proxy margins as supplied constants and does not deliver pointwise observable diameter adaptation or homogeneous-law converses.
fill: The project proves a direct pairwise moment-to-law modulus divided by the smaller observable covariance, a strength-free total positive-law lattice estimator, a globally honest profiled confidence image with local expected-diameter control, and matched homogeneous lower experiments for all four decision criteria.
